title: Clocks
summary: A clock is a 60-minute template of an hour on air. It is a list of elements, and each element takes one track from one or more playlists. The grid decides which clock plays in which hour.

entities.text: One slot of the hour. It names its playlists, a nominal duration, a tolerance, and where it is placed.
Start (before everything else), end (after everything else), in flow (in order among the others), or a fixed minute such as :30.
Starts at its minute within ±1 minute. Fixed elements split the hour into segments, and each segment is filled separately. A new fixed element at the same time replaces the old one.
The length the element aims for and how far a track may differ from it. Audio is never stretched: the system picks a track that fits.
An element may use playlists of different types, for example music and jingle. The track is chosen from all of them together.
What fills a segment that ends up short: a pool of chosen tracks, a playlist, an artist, a random track, or ask at air time.
Used when the clock's filler pool is empty or a filler reminder expires: random, a playlist, or an artist. If the clock has none, the global fallback from the settings applies.

usage: Build the hour from elements, then save. Saving runs a dry check and shows how full each segment is, which tracks are available, and any warnings. If a segment is short, a dialog asks how to fill it before the clock is complete.
steps: Click Add clock and enter a name.
Add elements: choose their playlists, nominal duration, tolerance, and placement.
Put news or station IDs at fixed minutes, for example :00 and :30.
Save and read the dry-check result and warnings.
If the filler dialog opens, choose a filler mode for each short segment, or save the clock incomplete.
Assign the clock to hours on the Grid page.
mistakes: Placing two fixed elements so close that their ±1 minute windows overlap. The newer one replaces the older one.
Putting more material before a fixed element than fits before its minute. The clock is not saved, and the element is marked.
Using a tolerance of 0. Very few tracks then fit, and segments end up short.
Closing the filler dialog with "save incomplete" and forgetting it. Reminders are created for every affected hour until you choose a filler.

example.title: A news hour
example.text: Element 1: news, fixed at :00, 5 minutes. Element 2: jingle, fixed at :30, 30 seconds. Elements 3 to 14: music from "Pop hits" and "New releases", in flow, 3:30 each with 30 seconds tolerance. Saving shows that the segment from :05 to :30 is short by 40 seconds, so the dialog asks for a filler; choose the playlist "Short songs".

operations.create: Saving runs the dry check first. Problems are shown at once, not at air time.
operations.edit: Only planned hours that have not started are rebuilt. Hours on air keep their plan.
operations.delete: A clock used in the grid or with play history cannot be deleted. Remove it from the grid first.

name.label: Name
name.text: A name you will recognize in the grid, for example "Weekday morning".

placement.label: Placement
placement.text: Start, end, in flow, or at a fixed minute of the hour.

fixed_minute.label: Fixed minute
fixed_minute.text: Minute of the hour, 0 to 59. The element may start up to one minute before or after it.

fixed_tolerance_ms.label: Fixed tolerance
fixed_tolerance_ms.text: How far the start of a fixed element may move, in milliseconds. Default 60000 (one minute).

nominal_duration_ms.label: Nominal duration
nominal_duration_ms.text: The length this element aims for, in milliseconds.

duration_tolerance_ms.label: Tolerance
duration_tolerance_ms.text: How much shorter or longer the chosen track may be, in milliseconds. Larger values make it easier to find a track.

playlist_ids.label: Playlists
playlist_ids.text: One or more playlists of any type. The track is chosen from all of them together.

filler_mode.label: Filler mode
filler_mode.text: How a short segment ending with this element is filled: pool, playlist, artist, random, or ask at air time.

filler_source_id.label: Filler source
filler_source_id.text: The playlist or artist for the playlist and artist filler modes.

default_filler_mode.label: Default filler mode
default_filler_mode.text: Used when the pool is empty or a reminder expires. Empty means the global fallback from the settings.

pool_track_ids.label: Filler pool
pool_track_ids.text: Tracks chosen for this clock, used one after another when the clock needs filler.
